## ConnectionsModule.acceptResponse() method

Accept a connection response as invitee (by sending a trust ping message) for the connection with the specified connection id. This is not needed when auto accepting of connection is enabled.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
acceptResponse(connectionId: string): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  connectionId | string | the id of the connection for which to accept the response |
